batch.label: Install selected games
batch.reviewSummary: {{ready}} ready to install, {{waiting}} waiting. Every selected game is saved to your Library. Waiting games aren't installed.
batch.running_one: Installing {{count}} game. Each game is checked again before anything changes. No game will be launched.
batch.running_other: Installing {{count}} games. Each game is checked again before anything changes. No game will be launched.
batch.stillRunning: Part of this batch is still in progress or its game is busy with another task. Check again later; nothing more was started for those games.
batch.unfinished_one: A setup batch didn't finish. {{count}} game was included. Continuing checks each game again and doesn't repeat finished installs.
batch.unfinished_other: A setup batch didn't finish. {{count}} games were included. Continuing checks each game again and doesn't repeat finished installs.
batch.unknownSpace: Space needed is unknown for <games/>. Each is checked before it runs.
batch.volumeEnough_one: <games/> needs {{required}} of temporary space on the same drive, which has {{available}} free.
batch.volumeEnough_other: <games/> need {{required}} of temporary space on the same drive, which has {{available}} free.
batch.volumeShort_one: <games/> needs {{required}} of temporary space on the same drive, which has {{available}} free. That isn't enough for all of them; later games may stop for space.
batch.volumeShort_other: <games/> need {{required}} of temporary space on the same drive, which has {{available}} free. That isn't enough for all of them; later games may stop for space.
batch.volumeUnknown_one: <games/> needs {{required}} of temporary space on the same drive. Its free space is unknown; each game is checked before it runs.
batch.volumeUnknown_other: <games/> need {{required}} of temporary space on the same drive. Its free space is unknown; each game is checked before it runs.

managedRoute.checking: Checking the recommended release and destination…
managedRoute.description: Portcove prepares a separate copy and switches to it only after verification. Your current registration stays usable until then, and its external files stay where they are.
managedRoute.differentHandling: This proposed change has different file or data handling. Keep your current copy and update Portcove before reviewing it again.
managedRoute.failure: The route change was not confirmed. Review the current installation before trying again.
managedRoute.optionsNote: These choices are saved for future managed installs. They do not move or change your external files.
managedRoute.preserves: Portcove updates the new installation and preserves the saves and settings covered by its recorded rules. Your external saves are not copied. A game that uses an upstream profile may still read the same profile when you choose Play; keep a separate backup of that data.
managedRoute.previousFiles: Your previous files remain at <path/>. You can keep using them separately. The saved update policy stays in effect; Play remains a separate action.
managedRoute.title: Use a managed copy of <name/>?

preparation.intro: Portcove uses your own copy of the game to finish setting up this installed version. Your original files and saved data aren't changed.
preparation.keepOpen: Keep Portcove open. You can continue browsing and revisit this task in Activity.

plan.activationText: Your original files and current installation remain unchanged until the verified result becomes active. The previous version stays available for rollback.
plan.duringInterrupt: Cancellation or interruption may leave working files in Activity. Starting again keeps earlier unfinished work.
plan.duringOpen: Keep Portcove open. Continue browsing and revisit progress in Activity.

plan.needsText: <size /> free, plus what the game creates
plan.originalSafe: Your original game files aren't changed.
plan.windowText: Finish setup in that window, then close it without starting the game. Portcove will check the files. If the checks pass, it will switch to the new version.

status.cancelled: Setup cancelled. Check Recent activity for unfinished work.

another.body: Keep using your current installation while preparing another copy. Downloading leaves its files and launch details unchanged. Review the new game program before switching. Check the project’s instructions for any shared save locations.
